description: We are a group of enthusiasts from Sri Lanka, looking forward to being a  renaissance in science for our country
summary: team TESLA SUMMIT developed a system called "VOID ROOTS" where wellbeing of the farming society is given the highest priority. Void Roots will use NASA satellite data, information of the soil from the pinned location of the user and do a budget analysis to prioritize the goals of the user and recommend crop rotation patterns or crop harvesting. VOID ROOTS serves as a supporting tool for decision making as mentioned in the challenge and also uses NASA data to uplift the agricultural sector. A system like VOID ROOTS is extremely important is the current world. Because farming industry is the only industry in the world which has the capacity to make billions suffer if went extinct. Yet the number of farmers are reducing gradually , though most of them blame the weather or the soil mostly, the real problem is improper decision making . This is where VOID ROOTS act as a game changer. We understood a very simple reality , if the sky and the soil is studied we can do farming by adopting to the environment. And that is exactly what VOID ROOTS implement.
details:
DOCUMENTED INFO OF VOID ROOTS

1)     What is VOID ROOTS?

The vision;

VOID ROOTS uses accurate data from NASA satellites, soil information of various areas and data of various seeds and plants that are used in agriculture to produce agricultural products , and incorporate them into a system originally created by the founders (TESLA SUMMIT) to aid farmers in making decisions about their plantation patterns. This software only serves as a supporting tool for farmers, which means VOID ROOTS  is not built to make the decision, rather to just provide opinion based on user’s preference.

 

EX; If the user’s preference is to have a crop rotation with less water consumption, VOID ROOTS will read the weather using the satellites, understand the soil type and choose the plants/seeds from its data base that best align with the user requirement and lay down 2 to 3 combination of rotation patters max.

 

Boons;

Though farming has been a traditional livelihood for centuries, most of the framers in society face difficulty in harvest during certain time periods or most of the time during a year. Mostly it’s the weather or the land, that is blamed for this situation, but even in bad weather if we really study the soil and the sky we can produce a good harvest which would save framers from sufferings due to incorrect decisions. Farming has kept the human civilization alive to see their greatest achievements, If all of them quit today, we would be wiped out of existence by months. So, VOID ROOTS is a tribute to all suffering framers and our ancestors. The best crop rotations could be suggested to the farmers, not just based on their requirements and the soil but also with accurate weather prediction and the economic benefits of the farmers in mind.

 

The capability of technology in agricultural field will reach its peak when VOID ROOTS reaches to the public.

 

2)     Expected change in society/market

 

Efficient Farming;

VOID ROOTS is going to increase the efficiency of farming by allocating the resources expected to be spent by the user efficiently and keeping the user aware of the consequences of any changes or decisions taken apart from the originally recommended patterns.

 

Better life for farmers;

In countries like India or Sri Lanka the land is well suitable for farming, but due to some incorrect decisions taken by framers about their crops they experience financial burden and either give up agriculture or take their own lives. So, VOID ROOTS is expected to enlighten the framers of the most suitable and beneficial patterns, and also to warn them of any wrong moves and their possible consequences. We believe that a country with happy farmers is a country with blessings.

 

 

3)     Uniqueness of VOID ROOTS

 

The function;
 VOID ROOTS doesn’t tell the user to use or follow a certain patter only. It suggests the best and also provide the possible repercussions of any differences. This is very important because no system can replace the centuries old experience that framing pass down.

 

Variable analysis;

 VOID ROOTS consider the most important variables and breaks down its decision to suite the differences in the variables. This is where our technology manages to fix the bug in the farming industry. Though modern farming technologies are built to control the environment around the crop ex: Greenhouse framing, VOID ROOTS analyses the environment and gives the best crops that can survive the surrounding without issues. This solution would be most effective because neither does it require great IT knowledge nor expensive machinery. Just a screen and internet is all you need.

 

Target market;

The target is on the society’s most important labor force the Farmers. Their well-being and requirement is given great priority.

 

STEP BY STEP GUIDE THROUGH THE WEBSITE

The tabs;

o   Home page- The home page tab provides an introduction and a briefed idea on what VOID ROOTS is and how to benefit off of it.

 

o   The overview tab- This is where Common data previously input by the user or the data fetched from the system recently, could be accessed through this, along with the details of the land area and its variable values. If any environmental alerts were issued or recognized previously, this tab will visually show them.

 

o   Field intelligence tab- This could be considered as the core of the project. In the field intelligence tab is where the inputs of the variables are given.

 

Land map – Soil information - Climate and SAR – Economy & Water – Goals (Order in which the data input would be taken.)

                     Different chambers have been allocated for these inputs.

 

Land map allows you type your location or to choose the location through the map. To further make the location tracking accurate, we have designed to show the coordinates as well. Simply land maps locates the user’s land location. The data would be sent to the SI assistant for decision making.

 

Soil Info chamber is where the information of the soil of user’s land could be input. The site uses multiple methods to do this. The input could be given through manual entry if you have done the necessary tests and have the proper data. Or it could be fetched through API where previously recorded soil data is stored. If not the user could run the tests himself if he’s got the proper devices and integrate it to the system as an input. The inputs could be done one by one or all three at once. But doing all at once (manual entry, API input and IoT device input) could help to understand the soil much accurately and give out much precise advices. After the inputs are completed, the integration sector will combine all the data and send the data to the SI assistant for final decision making.

 

Climate and SAR chamber is where the NASA satellites are used for weather prediction. The data output from this chamber will reach the SI as well, for the final verdict.

 

Economy & Water chamber is where the system focuses on water concerns and financial status of the user. The user’s access to water and budget is given high priority when SI makes its decisions.

 

Goals of the user is given the most priority by the SI when it processes the raw data input and gives out the output.

 

o   SI Assistant tab- As hinted in many instances this is the most interactive section in the whole system. The user will be given the crop pattern and its boons and banes based on the inputs and goals of the user through this tab. And any further doubts too would be clarified through this. This is the output tab of VOID ROOTS.

 

o   Equipment and devices tab is a part of a future version that will be in the system. All the devices of the user related to agriculture and has the ability to input data can be connected to the system through this tab, and will be extremely useful during the decision-making process since its feeding data in real time.

 

o   Farming history tab- This is similar to the search history and follows a similar mechanism. The history of recommended crops would appear here.

 

o   Maintenance tab – this is where the system keeps you updated of the environment and the economy in the of NEWS

       4) Future Vision

                           I.          Upgrading the variable analysis to consider mild variables such as air quality and humidity.

                          II.          Launching a toolkit with every single equipment needed to analyze the environment.

                        III.          Maintaining a server with data of every single individual user

                        IV.          More on the way, stay stunned………………
dataRefs: Landsat and MODIS/VIIRS: Reflectance, NDVI, Vegetation Indices: Landsat (30‑meter resolution) and MODIS/VIIRS (250–1000 m) provide corrected reflectance, NDVI, vegetation indices, and indicators of plant stress, bare ground, and seasonal change. These datasets allow participants to map crop vigor, track seasonal transitions, detect high‑stress periods, and compare rotation options visually.

Agroclimatology & Meteorological Data: NASA POWER provides accessible solar, meteorological, and climatology datasets used widely in agriculture. The datasets include temperature, humidity, radiation, and derived indicators that help estimate crop water use, growing‑season conditions, frost risk, and climate suitability for potential rotation crops.

Open Access Agricultural Datasets: USDA’s Ag Data Commons provides open‑access agricultural datasets covering soils, crops, climate, land management, phenology, water quality, and ecological conditions. These datasets offer valuable ground‑based and agricultural context that can complement NASA’s satellite observations. Participants may use Ag Data Commons to incorporate local crop information, soil‑property measurements, management practices, and field‑level agricultural research into their models. These data can help SI tools align NASA’s environmental indicators with practical farm‑level constraints and crop‑rotation realities.

The WSS, maintained by USDA’s Natural Resources Conservation Service (NRCS), provides official U.S. soil data, including detailed soil maps, soil properties, drainage classifications, erosion risk, hydrologic ratings, and suitability for different land uses. Participants may use WSS to identify field‑specific soil characteristics—such as organic matter, texture, infiltration, and compaction risk—which can improve SI‑driven rotation recommendations. Integrating NASA Earth observations with WSS data may help teams build stronger, locally accurate interpretations of soil health and crop suitability.
